answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 provides strong evidence through enterprise conversion and pipeline quality, though realized long-term revenue is omitted. Memories 31 and 86 show durable or meaningful upstream activation and adoption improvements but do not establish qualified revenue impact. Memory 73 shows acquisition and revenue lift, but omits qualification, retention, margin, and durability—important risks with promotional pricing. Memory 91 is weakest because it reports only short-term engagement and first-action movement, with no evidence of durability, qualification, retention, or revenue.
